The '''Chancellor's Suite''' in the '''[[Imperial Palace/Legends|Presidential Palace]]''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was the primary office for the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It contained a four-sided chamber of reinforced transparisteel which gave the Supreme Chancellor an unobstructed 360 degree view of the cityscape. The last person to use the office was [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], as [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], his successor, and ultimately the last Supreme Chancellor prior to his [[Declaration of a New Order|creation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], would create [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|his own office]] in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]. It was later replaced altogether with the [[Imperial Throne Room]].
